RTX develops engineering solutions that help the nation and its allies defend freedoms and deter aggression. The company is seeking a Software Engineer I to develop real-time embedded software for airborne radar modes and capabilities, contribute across the software development lifecycle, and support integration, troubleshooting, requirements, and architecture activities.

Responsibilities
Work on technical problems and provide innovative solutions, with guidance as needed
Work at all phases of the SW development lifecycle, including SW/HW integration
Develop RT embedded SW, specifically pertaining to various radar modes and capabilities
Utilize investigation and troubleshooting skills to assess issues and develop solutions
Work with teams across multiple disciplines, internal and external
Join program and customer meetings/reviews
Support the team leads as needed regarding technical decision making, problem resolution
Help to ensure performance to technical, cost, schedule, quality
Support of system and software requirements and architecture generation and analysis as needed
Must be able to obtain "special access programs" (SAP/SAR) for continuation of employment
Work Location: Onsite at our El Segundo, CA Campus
